question: Explain how amateur astronomers can contribute to science even when research is not their main goal.
raw: O1: [S1] Amateur astronomers can contribute to science even when research is not their main goal by monitoring variable stars, double stars, sunspots, and occultations of stars by the Moon or asteroids. They also assist in discovering transient astronomical events such as comets, galactic novae, or supernovae in other galaxies. [1][2][3][4][5][6][7]
